name: Chat Input
description: Floating capsule input bar: left mode-switch button (44x44 circle) + pill-shaped text field + right send button (44x44 circle) embedded inside the capsule, long-press voice input support. Liquid glass aesthetic with soft shadow elevation and BackdropFilter blur(24).

variants.name: Todo Mode
variants.description: 模式切换按钮显示 todo 模式：mintDeep (primary-500) 背景 + 白色 swap_horiz 图标

variants.name: Chat Mode
variants.description: 模式切换按钮显示 chat 模式：primary-50 背景 + primary-500 swap_horiz 图标

variants.name: Recording
variants.description: Long-press triggered voice recording state: border 变 mintDeep@60%，背景无变化，录音提示 8x8 圆点 + 13px w500 文字（cancel=textTertiary, listening=danger）

states.name: default
states.description: Empty input with placeholder, send button hidden (scale 0.6)

states.name: has-text
states.description: Text entered, send button visible (AnimatedScale to 1.0) inside capsule on the right

states.name: pressed
states.description: Mode-switch button pressed: scale(0.88) 缩放效果

states.name: loading
states.description: AI processing, input field disabled, send button hidden

features.description: Long-press (500ms) to start voice recording, swipe up to cancel, release to send
